nama: PEMICU: PETITUM MENUNTUT HAK ASUH ANAK (OTOMATIS dari petitum/kumulasi SIPP; "ya" bila menuntut)
sql: SELECT IF(c.th = 1, 'ya', '') AS data FROM (SELECT w.*, IF(w.jn = 346, "#0046#", "#0047#") AS S, IF(w.jn = 346, "#0047#", "#0046#") AS I, IF(w.jn = 346, "#0100#", "#0104#") AS kerja_s, IF(w.jn = 346, 1, 0) AS ct, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'hadhanah|hadlanah|hadanah|hak asuh|hak pengasuhan|kuasa asuh|hak pemeliharaan|pemeliharaan anak|pengasuhan anak|asuhan anak|di bawah (asuhan|pemeliharaan)|berada (di bawah|dalam) (asuhan|pemeliharaan|hadhanah)' OR w.kh > 0, 1, 0) AS th, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'nafkah[^;]{0,60}anak|anak[^;]{0,60}nafkah|biaya (hidup|pemeliharaan|pendidikan|kebutuhan)[^;]{0,60}anak|biaya anak', 1, 0) AS tn, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'iddah|idah', 1, 0) AS ti, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'mut[^a-z]{0,4}ah', 1, 0) AS tm, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'madli|madhi|mahdhi|lampau|yang lalu|terhutang', 1, 0) AS td, IF(w.pet REGEXP 'harta bersama|harta gono|gono.?gini' OR w.kbh > 0, 1, 0) AS tb, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_h)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS ch, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_n)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS cn, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_i)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS ci, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_m)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS cm, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_d)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS cd, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b))='' THEN 'K' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b)) REGEXP 'tidak dapat diterima|niet ontvankelijk' THEN 'N' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b)) REGEXP 'tolak' THEN 'T' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b)) REGEXP 'sebagian' THEN 'S' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b)) REGEXP 'ex officio|karena jabatan' THEN 'X' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(w.r_b)) REGEXP 'kabul|seluruh' THEN 'A' ELSE 'K' END AS cb, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_h) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_h, LOCATE(':', w.r_h) + 1)), '') AS al_h, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_n) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_n, LOCATE(':', w.r_n) + 1)), '') AS al_n, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_i) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_i, LOCATE(':', w.r_i) + 1)), '') AS al_i, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_m) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_m, LOCATE(':', w.r_m) + 1)), '') AS al_m, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_d) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_d, LOCATE(':', w.r_d) + 1)), '') AS al_d, IF(LOCATE(':', w.r_b) > 0, TRIM(SUBSTRING(w.r_b, LOCATE(':', w.r_b) + 1)), '') AS al_b, IF(LOWER(w.r_h) REGEXP 'ayah|bapak|suami', IF(w.jn = 346, "#0046#", "#0047#"), IF(w.jn = 346, "#0047#", "#0046#")) AS hold, IF(LOWER(w.r_h) REGEXP 'ayah|bapak|suami', IF(w.jn = 346, "#0047#", "#0046#"), IF(w.jn = 346, "#0046#", "#0047#")) AS other, IF(LOWER(w.r_h) REGEXP 'ayah|bapak|suami', 'ayah kandung', 'ibu kandung') AS hub_hold, IF(LOWER(w.r_h) REGEXP 'ayah|bapak|suami', 'ibu kandung', 'ayah kandung') AS hub_other, IF(LOWER(w.r_mum) REGEXP 'mumayyiz' AND LOWER(w.r_mum) NOT REGEXP 'belum', 1, 0) AS mm, IF(w.v_ai = '', '', IF(w.v_ai REGEXP '^[Rr]p', CONCAT('sejumlah ', w.v_ai), w.v_ai)) AS ai_a, IF(w.v_am = '', '', IF(w.v_am REGEXP '^(berupa|sejumlah|sebesar|uang|emas|barang)', IF(w.v_am REGEXP '^(uang|emas|barang)', CONCAT('berupa ', w.v_am), w.v_am), IF(w.v_am REGEXP '^[Rr]p', CONCAT('berupa uang sejumlah ', w.v_am), CONCAT('berupa ', w.v_am)))) AS am_a, IF(w.v_ad = '', '', IF(w.v_ad REGEXP '^[Rr]p', CONCAT('sejumlah ', w.v_ad), w.v_ad)) AS ad_a, IF(w.v_an = '', '', IF(w.v_an REGEXP '^[Rr]p', CONCAT('sebesar ', w.v_an, ' setiap bulan'), w.v_an)) AS an_a, w.v_ak AS ak_a, IF(w.r_kmp <> '', w.r_kmp, CONCAT('bahwa ', IF(w.jn = 346, "#0046#", "#0047#"), ' bekerja sebagai ', IF(w.jn = 346, "#0100#", "#0104#"))) AS kmp, IF(w.r_byr <> '', LOWER(w.r_byr), IF(w.jn = 346, 'sebelum ikrar talak', IF(LOWER(w.v_9715) = 'ya', 'sebelum akta cerai', ''))) AS byr, IF(w.v_2004 <> '', w.v_2004, '') AS asuh_now FROM (SELECT p.jenis_perkara_id AS jn, LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(IFNULL(p.petitum,''), ' ', IFNULL((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.isi_petitum SEPARATOR ' ') FROM perkara_rekonvensi r WHERE r.perkara_id = p.perkara_id),'')),'',''),'',''),'',''),'',''),' ',' '),CHAR(10),' '),CHAR(13),' ')) AS pet, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perkara_kumulasi k WHERE k.perkara_id = p.perkara_id AND k.jenis_perkara_id = 349) AS kh, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perkara_kumulasi k WHERE k.perkara_id = p.perkara_id AND k.jenis_perkara_id = 348) AS kbh, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perkara_rekonvensi r WHERE r.perkara_id = p.perkara_id) AS rk, TRIM(i.i4100) AS r_h, TRIM(i.i4101) AS r_n, TRIM(i.i4102) AS r_i, TRIM(i.i4103) AS r_m, TRIM(i.i4104) AS r_d, TRIM(i.i4105) AS r_b, TRIM(i.i4106) AS r_mum, TRIM(i.i4107) AS r_kmp, TRIM(i.i4108) AS r_did, TRIM(i.i4109) AS r_byr, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.i6054),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9712),''), '') AS v_ai, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.i6055),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9713),''), '') AS v_am, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.i7120),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9711),''), '') AS v_ad, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9740),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i6071),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i6072),''), '') AS v_an, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9741),''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.i9050),''), '') AS v_ak, TRIM(i.i9715) AS v_9715, TRIM(i.i2004) AS v_2004, TRIM(i.i8503) AS v_8503, TRIM(i.i9944) AS v_9944, TRIM(i.i246) AS v_246, TRIM(i.i8730) AS v_8730 FROM perkara p JOIN (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4100 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4100, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4101 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4101, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4102 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4102, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4103 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4103, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4104 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4104, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4105 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4105, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4106 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4106, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4107 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4107, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4108 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4108, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 4109 THEN d.data END), '') AS i4109, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 6054 THEN d.data END), '') AS i6054, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9712 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9712, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 6055 THEN d.data END), '') AS i6055, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9713 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9713, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 7120 THEN d.data END), '') AS i7120, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9711 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9711, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9740 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9740, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 6071 THEN d.data END), '') AS i6071, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 6072 THEN d.data END), '') AS i6072, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9741 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9741, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9050 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9050, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9715 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9715, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 2004 THEN d.data END), '') AS i2004, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 8503 THEN d.data END), '') AS i8503, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 9944 THEN d.data END), '') AS i9944, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 246 THEN d.data END), '') AS i246, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN d.no_var = 8730 THEN d.data END), '') AS i8730 FROM (SELECT no_var, IFNULL(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(data USING utf8),'\\','/'),'"','"'),'''','''),'') AS data FROM aps_badilag.abt_data_teks WHERE perkara_id = '#perkara_id#' AND no_var IN (4100, 4101, 4102, 4103, 4104, 4105, 4106, 4107, 4108, 4109, 6054, 9712, 6055, 9713, 7120, 9711, 9740, 6071, 6072, 9741, 9050, 9715, 2004, 8503, 9944, 246, 8730)) d) i ON 1 = 1 WHERE p.perkara_id = '#perkara_id#') w) c
